statement: In the stated marked-incidence deformation problem with smooth leading plane cubic, every positive first-normal jet lies in the gauge image; the Hesse and Fermat model calculations give the exact determinant and rank certificates used by the global bundle argument.
title: Smooth Leading Cubics Have No Positive First-Normal Moduli
